name: RH
summary: RH, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a retailer and lifestyle brand in the home furnishings market in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, Belgium, and Spain. The company operates in three segments: RH Segment, Waterworks, and Real Estate. It offers merchandise in various categories, including furniture, lighting, textiles, bath ware, décor, and outdoor and garden furnishings, as well as baby, child, and teen furnishings. The company also operates galleries, interior design studios, outlets, guesthouses, and showrooms.
